module: Parking spot marker in play mode (for example to deliver or drop off a vehicle): a striped decal on the ground, a 3D outline (park_outline_marker.dae) whose height and opacity depend on speed, and a floating icon (poi_parking_rect by default). The player's vehicle is "parked" when its bounding box overlaps (overlap mode) or is contained in (contained mode) the spot, within 15 m and below about 20 km/h; the marker then becomes interactive. The module returns {create, cluster}.
notes: mode of a cluster: "overlap" (default, the vehicle's box touches a centered 1 m x 1 m box) or "contained" (the vehicle must fit entirely in the spot enlarged by 1 m in x/y).

cluster groups the POIs by path (markerInfo.parkingMarker.path); without a path, they go in the "noPath" group. The POIs take pos, rot, scl, mode, icon, focus from the first POI of the group; visibilityRadius = 5.
Bug: cluster computes count = #poisByPath on a string-keyed table: the value is always 0, so the condition count > 1 is false and the numbered icon (poi_no-0N) is never used.
Bug: C:setup reads the global variable parkDelay, never defined in this file: self.stopTimer is nil.
distance is a local variable of the module shared by all markers (updated by checkParking just before update); distanceToHeight ignores its argument and reads this variable.
Distances: the icon appears within 60 m (farDist) when not in focus and rises above the vehicle within 15 m (nearDist); with focus it stays displayed from afar with a bounce.
The ground decal is provided in groundDecalData (texture parkDecalStripes.png) and drawn by the marker manager; its fade distance grows by 20 m when the vehicle is parked.
isInAreaChanged is "in"/"out" for one frame; the drawAxisBox function and the old hexagonal version of drawOnMinimap (commented out) are not used.

create.desc: Builds a parking spot marker (instance of C).

cluster.desc: Groups the parkingMarker POIs by identical path and adds one cluster per group to allClusters.

pois.desc: POIs with markerInfo.parkingMarker {path, pos, rot, scl, mode, icon, focus}.

allClusters.desc: List of clusters completed in place.

init.desc: Assigns a numId and creates the smoothers (icon position, cruising, opacity, distance, overlap); visible = true.

setup.desc: Reads pos, rot, scl, mode from the cluster, computes the half-axes of the test box, creates the outline object (TSStatic) positioned and scaled on the spot, the icon and the ground decal.

update.desc: Every frame: calls checkParking, animates the icon's height and opacity, draws the line to the ground, adjusts the outline's height and opacity, updates isInAreaChanged and the decal's fade distance.

data.desc: Frame data: veh, bbCenter, bbHalfAxis0..2, camPos, camRot, playerPosition, isFreeCam, cruisingSpeedFactor, bigMapActive, highestBBPointZ, dt.

checkParking.desc: Computes the player/camera distance to the spot and determines overlap (and parked) according to the mode, within 15 m and below the cruising speed; sets the distance to 0 if parked.

createObject.desc: Creates and registers a TSStatic with instance color (used for the outline).

createObjects.desc: Cleans up existing objects (does not create new ones; the outline is created in setup).

hide.desc: Becomes invisible, makes the outline and the icon transparent.

show.desc: Becomes visible again and forces the outline update.

clearObjects.desc: Removes the outline (notifies the editor if present) and the floating icon.

interactInPlayMode.desc: If canInteract and the vehicle is parked, adds the cluster's data (elemData) to the interactive elements.

drawOnMinimap.desc: Draws a blue circle at the spot's position on the minimap.

drawAxisBox.desc: Draws a debug box (edges and faces) via debugDrawer; not used here.
